paper.title: Algorithm 883: SparsePOP---A Sparse Semidefinite Programming Relaxation of Polynomial Optimization Problems

claim.text: Shipped user manual Doc/UserManual/sect3.tex (section 'The GAMS scalar format'): the printed output of sparsePOP('example1.gms', param) with param.relaxOrder = 3 and SeDuMi eps 1e-9 (SparsePOP 2.00). The example is the POP of example1.m (minimize -2x1+3x2-2x3 subject to a quadratic inequality, two linear inequalities, one linear equality and box bounds). The claim is the line POP.objValue, the approximated optimal value of that POP.

attempt: Original archive run as shipped under Octave 10.3 failed (ver/pkg, findstr, strtok, common_size; no SeDuMi in archive). Patched: SeDuMi 1.3 built with installer edits and a BLAS typedef shim; pkg.m and findstr.m environment shims. The authors' SparsePOP files are unchanged. Two clean passes give -7.95509506 (paper -7.9550951, tol 1e-6).
